articles.title: Rabagirana Choir yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya “Wa Musaraba” (VIDEO)
articles.summary: Korali Rabagirana yo muri ADEPR Gatsata, ahazwi nka Gariraya, yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya yitwa “Wa Musaraba”, igaruka ku mumaro w’umusaraba Yesu Kristo yabambweho n’icyo igitambo cye gisobanuye…

articles.title: Imvo n'imvano: Ivyananiye Prezida Kabila mu myaka 18 agiye kubishobora ari muri FRN?
